description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded firearm.

Area 20-foot line or 15-foot burst within 60 feet

Duration 1 minute, or until you Dismiss it

Lay down a zone of suppressive fire allies can use as effective cover.

Sustain a curtain of fire across the area. Allies within or behind it gain standard cover against attacks that cross it, and enemies attempting to cross take a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls until the end of their turn. Sustaining costs you 1 action on each of your turns and empties one loaded weapon per turn sustained.
